tools.name: river_level_now
tools.description: Latest water level at one Environment Agency gauge, compared with its typical range (low, normal or high), plus the latest flow where the gauge measures it. Useful for boaters, anglers and residents asking whether the river is high right now. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API

tools.name: river_level_history
tools.description: River level readings at one gauge since a time (default the last 24 hours, up to 7 days back), with the lowest and highest point, change since the start and whether the river is rising, falling or steady over the last hour. Answers "has the river peaked yet" for flood watchers and anglers. Source: E

tools.name: river_stations_on_river
tools.description: Lists the Environment Agency level gauges on a named river in England (for example River Thames or River Severn) with station ids, towns and coordinates. tools.name: river_level_record
tools.description: Record high, record low and highest recent level at one Environment Agency gauge, with how far today's level is below the record.
